chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mu'amar ibn Khallad, who said:

Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) ordered me, so I made a flask for him containing musk and amber. He ordered me to write on a piece of paper the Verse of the Chair, the Mother of the Book, the Two Protecting Chapters, and some striking verses from the Quran, and to place it between the cover and the flask. So I did so, then I brought it to him, and he covered it with the covering while I was looking at him.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: The Verse of the Chair (Ayat al-Kursi)
key_terms.أُمَّ الْكِتَابِ: The Mother of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha)
key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: The Two Protecting Chapters (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Reza instruct regarding the preparation of the ghaliya perfume?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the Shia practice of *tawassul* through physical objects, where Imam Al-Reza (AS) instructed the inclusion of key Quranic chapters—specifically the Throne Verse, Surah Al-Fatiha, the two *Mu'awwidhat*, and selected verses—within a perfume flask. This act highlights the belief in the spiritual efficacy (*barakah*) of the Quranic text when preserved in daily items, serving as a tangible means of divine protection and blessing in the domestic sphere.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Moamar Bin Khallad who said,

‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws ordered me, so I made a flask for himasws in which was musk, and Amber. So heasws ordered me that I should write down in a paper the Verse of the Chair [2:255], and the Mother of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha), and Al-Mawazatain (Chapters 113 & 114), and certain Verses from the Quran, and make these to be in between the covering and the flask. So I did it, then I came over to himasws with it, and heasws placed it in a covering, and I was looking at himasws’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Mu’ammar ibn Khallad who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once commanded me to prepare for him oil mixed with musk and ambergris and write on paper verse 2:255, ’Umm al-Kitab, al-Ma‘udhatayn and al-Qawari’ (verse that crush Satan) from al-Quran; then place it in a cover in a bottle. I did as I was told to do. I then brought it to him (the Imam). He (the Imam) placed it in a cover and I was looking at him (the Imam).”’
